description: session.compact: the memory message from the observation ledger, with no model call, or a brief compiled by code where the Observer's memory cannot stand or a manual compaction has too little to observe; the kept recent messages leave out local slash commands, and their tool calls get fresh ids; its wait on the Observer has a deadline, and an abandoned compaction installs nothing; a compaction given instructions goes to the built-in compactor; prompt.section: a standing note on compaction and how to resume; ui.render: draws a collapsed memory message as one line and hides the copies of the recent messages it kept, and the /notes pane of the observations in view; turn.start: times the main conversation's prompts and keeps its recent turn starts; turn.step: observes a long turn mid-turn; turn.complete: observes the finished turn in the background through pi; session.start: registers om_recall, om_stats and, when interactive, /notes and, once a day, archives to a file and prunes sessions long untouched, then the oldest until the store has room to spare; store.set: archives and prunes the oldest sessions when the store is full; tool.call: runs om_recall and om_stats; tool.describe: keeps om_recall out of the deferred tools once the session has compacted; command.run: /om-stats, and /notes opens the observations pane; classic.SessionStart and classic.Stop: record the transcript path; session.end: ends the loop's background work and kills its pi calls, and a /clear drops the session's state; skill.prompt: records the skills the session loads
